yourNature_desc: You are what the sword is like when it is drawn and never hung back on the wall. Because you carry more Metal than you spend, your need to name what is true never takes a day off. You would rather say the hard thing today than keep the peace for a week. Over time you keep your honesty and lose the easy closeness you also want.

self_card.face: A blade that never leaves the hand
self_card.presence: You run full all the time, with more to say than any moment needs. You spend your strength holding it in or paying for letting it out.

_trace.yourNature_desc: more Metal than is spent makes the need to name the truth constant, which trades closeness for honesty
_trace.presence: the surplus costs strength whether held in or let out
